samples.prompt: user: My Node service crashes with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined at startup. Where should I look first?
samples.response: I'm sorry to hear your Node service is crashing. This error usually means your code is trying to access a property on an object that hasn't been defined yet. To troubleshoot systematically, first check the exact line mentioned in the error stack trace to identify which variable is undefined. Next, review the code leading up to that line to ensure all objects are properly initialized before use. It can also help to add console logs before the error line to inspect variable states. If you have asynchronous code, verify that any data dependencies are resolved before accessing their properties. If you want, I can guide you through these steps in more detail.
